dedupe_keys.name: plstm reg v1 0 a regional physics encoded lstm model for simulating reservoir operations under data scarcity

description: Bin Yu publishes PLSTM-Reg v1.0, a physics-encoded LSTM for simulating reservoir operations across sites when local training data are scarce. Zenodo provides Python source, a configuration example and a detailed README with public access. The model embeds dynamic and static features, predicts release and storage, enforces daily mass balance, and clamps storage to each reservoir’s capacity. It is designed for integration with NeuralHydrology and can be trained against the separately deposited 256-reservoir United States dataset. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this model. A limitation is that the optional release bounds were disabled in the reported experiments because reservoir-specific limits were unavailable; predicted releases therefore are not operational permits. The README adopts NeuralHydrology’s BSD-3-Clause code licence by reference, while Zenodo metadata has no licence identifier. No code was installed or run, and predictive skill was not reproduced.
